yotta-code-quality v0.4.3

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md and CHANGELOG.md.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.
- package.json updated to reflect the new version.
- No core logic or functionality changes; this is a maintenance and documentation update.

- Added category field to SKILL.md metadata.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md.
- Documentation updated in CHANGELOG.md and SKILL.md.
- Minor maintenance and script adjustments in install scripts and package.json.
- Editorial notes and references updated.

- Added new frontmatter fields to SKILL.md: slug, displayName, summary, tags, homepage.
- Expanded SKILL.md summary and tags for better discoverability and localization.
- Removed unused and non-essential files: LICENSE, NOTICE, assets/banner.png, skill-card.md, test/install.test.js.
- Minor editorial and metadata improvements for skill clarity and compatibility.
SkillHub evaluation refinements: FAQ, walkthroughs, hardened installer and tests.

- Removed the file: skill-card.md
- No other changes to core logic, documentation, or functionality.

yotta-code-quality v0.3.4

- Documentation cleanup: removed unused or duplicate documentation files (e.g., skill-card.md).
- Updated SKILL.md and README files to improve clarity and accuracy.
- No changes to review logic or risk taxonomy.
- Minor maintenance to align documentation with current implementation.

- Added detailed changelog file (CHANGELOG.md), legal notice (NOTICE), and Simplified Chinese documentation (README.zh-CN.md)
- Updated core documentation files: README.md, SKILL.md, package.json
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md to streamline documentation
- Expanded multilingual and legal support for broader community use

- Improved documentation clarity and explicit workflow defaults in SKILL.md.
- Reinforced “Iron Law” for review findings: Symptom → Source → Consequence → Remedy.
- Added detailed mode-based load rules and review triggers/exclusions.
- Made severity thresholds, risk codes (R1–R6, T1–T6, R7, UX1), and session contract explicit.
- Clarified companion files' roles and moved canonical templates and score math to `references/common.md`.
- No functional changes to review logic—documentation and guardrail enhancements only.
